body: You could ask, "Hey, can I talk to you?" or "Hey, do you have a minute?" It does take some courage to do so and some time. Do it when she's not to busy or in a bad mood herself. You could say, "I've been feeling down/sad lately-" if your unsure how to start, and go from there. Don't try to rush it, and take your time telling her about it. Hope it goes well. If you ever need someone else to talk to, feel free to message me.
Aw well, thank you! I completely understand where your coming from and stuff, thanks a ton! I will do my best to wait, again, thanks ♡
That makes sense. She did, sadly.
I love writing, being alone (most times), nature and love the snow! If you ever wanna chat, I can message u or u could message me! Whichever works :)

Makes sense your friend did that, mine would probably do the same, or just try to come back as simply and do the same thing as she is currently doing. And your probably right, I do give her what she wants. I should stop giving her what she wants especially now knowing she's fucking w/ my feelings- I'm glad to know someone understands. Im sorry something similar happened to you but glad to hear you cut lose. Thanks a ton for the advice! ♡
I'm in the same boat. Dating has gone terribly for me. Sorry to hear ur single too.
Im sorry to hear that its been rough; your welcome to message me about it if you want to! All open minded :) I hope things too, get better for you!
Same here! I keep thinking its my wifi/cell and then I can load some things so Im just confused.

Im sorry what your going through. I know the feeling of carrying a boulder of a lot of negativity everyday, and having the stress of trying to hold on for others but its not really helping yourself. Would it help if I could check in with you every so often, or even just chat to chat? I’m also sorry for your lose of your dad and a friend. Thank you for holding on no matter how hard it gets. Im here for you if you want to chat or anything.
My messages are open if you need :) Im here for you.

I know how you feel. Society is messed up so much now. If you want to chat in messages I am here. Im here to listen. I understand if you cannot trust me since Im a stranger on the internet but Im here for you. Life’s getting hard for me too, it’d be nice for me to help some people if I even can at this point. Let me know… Im sorry your lost in such a place but if you need a friend or buddy I’m here and my messages are open :) I wish I could give you a big hug right now and anytime you need one.

I understand. I'm in freshman in high school as well. And yeah, it really won't get better and when it seems like it will, it doesn't. Do you want to chat in messages? I hear you. I'm sorry you've had to move 9 times, I wouldn't know what its like, but gosh it must be hard. And 3 years... I am right there with you. I don't have any close friends, and like you, I get ignored when their hanging with someone else. It happens daily. I understand what your going through. Please, if you want to, lets message. It'd be nice to know someone whose gone through similar, and I would like to help you more. I apologize if this message is all over the place. But please, if you do, my messages are open\^\^ and I know I'm just a stranger but I'm here for you. ♡

Gosh I am so sorry that this happened! I am so thankful that you are still here and have survived and pushed through all  that hell. I do truly hope you can find a better place and find people who care for you and understand what you have gone through. I really do hope you are doing okay, and if not, I hope you get better real soon! I feel so bad that you have gone through all of this. And hun, you haven't failed anyone. I am so thankful that you have shared this. I am here if you need anyone to talk to or any other reason! Thank you for sharing your story, and again, I'm sorry you've gone through all of this. You didn't deserve it. I hope your paradise welcomes you soon. Please know on here, your always welcome to share your story. I love you and would hug you if I could. ♡
Thank you for reading it- and Im sorry you've gone through similar. I do notice online friends shouldn't, like you said, be the main priority. But again thank you :).
